meta.title: Personal Loan Calculator | Achieve-style demo
meta.description: Estimate monthly payments, total interest, and total cost for an amortizing personal loan. Sample rates are illustrative only.

header.title: Personal loan calculator
header.intro: Estimate monthly payments, total interest, and total cost for an amortizing personal loan. Adjust amount, APR, term, and optional origination fee.

demoBanner.strong: Sample rates for demo only — not an offer.
demoBanner.body: Figures are illustrative estimates for education and UX prototyping. Actual rates, fees, and eligibility depend on credit review and lender terms.

loanAmount.label: Loan amount
loanAmount.hint: Amount you want to borrow (before fee).

apr.label: APR
apr.hint: Illustrative sample APR for demo (mid-single to low-teens range).

originationFee.label: Origination fee (optional)
originationFee.hint: Fee is financed into principal by default (you receive the loan amount; payments amortize principal + fee). See results for cash received and financed balance.

results.heading: Your estimate
results.invalidMessage: Fix the highlighted fields to see an estimate.
results.unableMessage: Unable to calculate with these inputs.
results.summaryTemplate: {{months}} payments · fee mode: financed into principal{{feeNote}}

cta.label: Check your rate
cta.note: Placeholder CTA — not a live application. Checking a rate may use a soft inquiry depending on the lender.

amortization.heading: Amortization snapshot
amortization.emptyRow: Enter valid inputs to see schedule.

footer.note: This calculator is a self-contained demo styled to resemble public Achieve.com visual patterns. It does not constitute a loan offer, quote, or guarantee of savings or approval. Sample default APR is for demonstration only.

validationMessages.termMin: Term must be at least 1 month.
validationMessages.termMax: Term must be at most 480 months.
